name: ingest_sources
description: Create or refresh indexes for a local path. Use domains code, docs, or auto.

name: catalog_sources
description: List indexed sources (code and docs) with capabilities and hints. Code and docs for the same workspace share one `source_id`, distinguished by the `domains` field on each entry. On downstream calls, pass `source_id` together with the `domain` you want to query (where supported).

name: search_catalog
description: Unified search over symbols, sections, and file text. When `domain` is omitted, defaults to `code` for `keyword`/`regex` query modes and `hybrid` for `natural_language`. The effective values are echoed back in `_meta.domain_effective` and `_meta.query_mode_effective`.

domain.description: When omitted, defaults to `code` for keyword/regex and `hybrid` for natural_language. Pass explicitly to override.

query_mode.description: regex mode auto-routes to file-text search (unit_kinds ignored).

context_lines.description: Lines of context before/after for file text hits (code domain, unit_kinds file).

max_tokens.description: Optional cap on serialized size of items (token_budget alias). Uses BYTES_PER_TOKEN (~4 bytes per token).

fuzzy.description: Augment symbol hits with fuzzy name matching (trigram Jaccard + optional edit distance) in the code domain.

fuzzy_threshold.description: Trigram Jaccard threshold for fuzzy candidates (default 0.3). When set and BM25 finds no symbols, fuzzy runs even if fuzzy=false.

max_edit_distance.description: Optional Levenshtein cutoff on a normalized compare key; pairs within this distance may match even when trigram similarity is low.

semantic.description: Augment symbol/section retrieval with dense embeddings. `query_mode=natural_language` implies this automatically; when dense retrieval is unavailable or the request only targets files, the response succeeds with a `SEMANTIC_FALLBACK` warning.

output_mode.description: items (default): full results. count: {count, files} only. files_with_matches: [{file, count}].

pattern.description: Alias for query when query_mode=regex. Cannot be set together with query.

name: read_content
description: Batch read symbols, sections, or files by ref.

name: inspect_structure
description: Tree, outline, TOC, and document structure views.

path.description: file_tree: optional subtree prefix (repo-relative). file_outline: file path.

class_path.description: class_hierarchy: required — name of the class to root the hierarchy on.

max_files.description: file_tree only: max files before truncation (default 500).

max_tokens.description: Optional token budget (≈4 bytes/token) applied to file_tree and repo_outline.

name: inspect_graph
description: Reference, import, and dependency graph queries.

symbol_id.description: calls: required — stable id of the symbol whose call sites to enumerate.

file_path.description: imports/importers: required — file path whose imports (outgoing) or importers (incoming) to enumerate.

identifier.description: find_references: required — identifier to search for.

identifiers.description: find_references: batch form — multiple identifiers to search for in a single call.

include_call_chain.description: find_references: include calling-symbol chain info on each hit.

fqn.description: resolve_fqn: required — fully-qualified name to resolve.

cross_repo.description: dependencies: include cross-repo package edges when true.

max_tokens.description: dependencies: optional token budget (≈4 bytes/token) for edges/nodes. Alias `token_budget`.

name: evaluate_impact
description: Change-oriented analysis: blast radius, rename safety, diffs, and since-commit change reports.

refs.description: blast_radius/impact_preview/rename_safety: required, at least refs[0] as a symbol ref. rename_safety additionally requires `new_name` on refs[0]. diff: exactly two symbol refs in the same file. changed_units: one or two commit refs ({kind: 'commit', id: '<sha>'}); one compares against HEAD.

new_name.description: rename_safety only: the proposed new symbol name.

name: evaluate_quality
description: Quality metrics: complexity, repo_health, dead_code, hotspots, doc_coverage, broken_links, quality_signal, regression_check, test_gaps. `quality_signal` returns structural root causes plus 4 agent-readiness dimensions (navigability, comprehensibility, verifiability, change_safety) and their sub-metrics; `regression_check` compares the same snapshot dimensions.

refs.description: complexity: required symbol ref. doc_coverage: required list of symbol refs (capped at 200).

granularity.description: dead_code: file or symbol granularity (default file).

top_n.description: hotspots / dead_code / refactor_targets: cap the returned list size (default 50 for hotspots/refactor_targets, 25 for dead_code).

top_files.description: refactor_targets (repo mode, when file_path is omitted): number of hottest files to scan (default 10).

file_path.description: refactor_targets: file to scope the scan to. Omit for repo-wide mode over the hottest `top_files`.

max_tokens.description: dead_code: serialized-response token budget (≈4 bytes/token). Trims dead_files/dead_symbols until the response fits. Alias: token_budget.

name: assemble_context
description: Bundle search+read, section neighbor context, or suggestions.

refs.description: section_context: required — one section ref. context_bundle: required — one symbol ref. Same shape as read_content refs.

max_tokens.description: section_context: cap primary section body. context_bundle / ranked: token budget (≈4 bytes/token). Alias: token_budget.

token_budget.description: Alias of max_tokens for context_bundle and ranked.

budget_strategy.description: context_bundle: compact (strip sources) or most_relevant (ordering label; packing uses token budget when set).

include_budget_report.description: context_bundle: include budget_report block when true.

include_kinds.description: ranked: filter symbol hits to these kinds (e.g. class).

old_name.description: rename_plan: existing symbol name being renamed. Falls back to `query` when unset.

new_name.description: rename_plan: proposed new name used for collision checks.

name: manage_indexes
description: Invalidate, delete, rebuild, status, snapshot_quality, or session_stats. Most actions target a single source and require `source_id`; `session_stats` is global and does not. `rebuild` additionally requires `root_hint`.

snapshot_name.description: snapshot_quality: logical name for the snapshot (default "session"). Overwrites existing.
